name_input: M/S SUPREME PETROCHEM LTD.; M/S SUPREME PETROCHEM LTD.; M/S SUPREME PETRO CHEM LTD; SUPREME PETROCHEM LTD.; SUPREME PETROCHEM LIMITED; SUPREME PETROCHEM LTD
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page for SUPREME PETROCHEM LTD (404, Raheja Chambers, Nariman Point): "Total Shipments 3770 Records detected ... Latest Cargo 2026-02-28"; row seen: "2026-02-28 SUPREME PETROCHEM LTD CHEM-L-PLAST (PTY) LTD POLYSTYRENE BLACK MASTERBATCH GRADE SP7305 7538- NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India Durban, S AFRICA 32064990 1129629"; further rows: "2026-02-25 SUPREME PETROCHEM LTD LORD INTERNATIONAL, GENERAL PURPOSE POLYSTYRENE GRADE SC203EL- ... El Dekheila, EGYPT 39031990 1008894" and "2026-02-24 SUPREME PETROCHEM LTD SINGER SRI LANKA PLC GENERAL PURPOSE POLYSTYRENE GRADE SC201LV- ... Colombo, Sri Lanka 39031990 9967283". Source counter: page claims 3770 total shipments; 5 individual rows actually rendered on the free view (3 of them outbound exports with date, destination, HS and B/L number).
domestic_evidence: Company site (supremepetrochem.com) states "Customer base in 100+ countries" and describes India's first and only international-scale styrenics complex at Amdoshi (Nagothane) plus a Chennai EPS plant — this is a corporate claim, not a supply record. No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or contract document could be retrieved: thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403, and no public procurement record was seen in the pages read. Domestic sales volume therefore not independently confirmed in this pass.
note: Manufacturer (own PS/EPS/ABS plants at Nagothane, Maharashtra and Chennai, Tamil Nadu), not a trader. Declared HS 290512 (propylene glycol / acetone-class oxygenates) does NOT match the observed shipment HS codes: exports are 39031990 (general purpose polystyrene) and 32064990 (masterbatch/pigment preparation); imports are 29011000 (pentane) and 32061110 (titanium dioxide). Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground — company stays in the base with actual HS corrected to 39031990 (primary export product: polystyrene) and verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Export activity is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L rows (Feb 2026, Durban / El Dekheila / Colombo), not merely by website wording. Revenue figure not verified in this pass (annual reports are linked on the site but not parsed) — left null rather than estimated.
